metadata.title: Temporally Validated Forecast Combinations on Two Benchmark Collections
metadata.description: This study evaluates temporally validated combinations of five local forecast experts on eligible M4 Weekly and M3 Monthly series. The protocol retains complete historical validation and reserved-origin forecasts. Validated mixtures improve mean MASE relative to the recency-only control on both collections. AutoTheta retains lower monthly mean MASE and lower mean interval score in both collections.
metadata.version_notes: Adds temporal selection derivations, full source and origin accounting, paired case-level uncertainty, measured worker timings and a reproducible standalone manuscript build.
